rows.law: standing-burn cadence: cron every 2h, 3 disjoint topics per fire, offpeak deep dives between fires, paid spend window-gated
rows.claim: The burn queue refuels itself without operator input: a MANIFEST topic list plus cron fires 3 parallel single-topic agents per 2h window, offpeak idle tasks carry deep dives, paid DeepSeek obeys protocol.deepseek_windows.
rows.quote: cron every 2h: 3 topics per fire, parallel background agents, one topic each; offpeak idle tasks carry single-topic deep dives between fires; paid DeepSeek work obeys protocol.deepseek_windows
rows.steal: Any idle fleet can self-refuel: keep a topic manifest with pointers, fire cron-batched parallel single-topic agents, gate paid calls to off-peak windows; work generation needs no operator in the loop.
rows.falsifier: ledger timestamps show fires more than 2h apart with no offpeak deep dives between, or a paid DeepSeek call inside a peak window

rows.claim: Every burn must land a max 500 word receipt with fixed sections Verdict / Evidence / Steal or Vacuous / Falsifier / closed Bibliography of only sources actually read, and the ledger row points at it.
rows.quote: watch/inbox/BURN_<slug>_<YYYYMMDD>.md, max 500 words, fixed sections: Verdict / Evidence (quotes) / Steal or Vacuous / Falsifier if build proposed / Bibliography (closed, only sources actually read)
rows.steal: Bounded fixed-section receipts with closed bibliographies make parallel agent output mergeable and auditable without re-reading; adopt for every fan-out lane so trust is structural, not per-read.
rows.falsifier: an orphan receipt not referenced by any ledger row, or a receipt missing a fixed section; today bijection held (0 orphan, 0 missing)

rows.claim: Topics never repeat while green; solved topics demote and reranking is driven by unresolved-failure count, then in-distribution fit, then learning progress (fresh failure modes beat repeated ones).
rows.quote: round-robin due-oldest-first by ledger; solved topics demote, never repeat while green (PAT learning-progress key)
rows.steal: Rank work queues by fresh-failure count instead of age or recency; a green verdict is terminal for that topic per cycle, so compute never re-solves settled questions.
rows.falsifier: two ledger rows for one slug where the earlier verdict is green and a later fire reruns it; roblox-durable-lane greened once at 14:06Z and demoted, no repeat fired

rows.law: churn re-verifies quota denominators; cached tokens are the stealth window
rows.claim: Free-lane churn tracked model counts but missed Groq cutting text-model free RPD from 14.4K to 1K, overdrawing wave math about 14x; meanwhile cached tokens bypass rate limits so frozen-prefix signatures ride free.
rows.quote: Cached tokens do not count towards your rate limits
rows.steal: Re-verify quota-per-day denominators every churn pass, not just model lists, and route deliberate-ask frozen-prefix traffic through provider prompt caching since cached tokens skip the TPM wall.
rows.falsifier: a provider doc changing cached-token accounting, or wave math on a stale RPD denominator 429ing a lane (already fired once with the 14.4K figure)

rows.claim: Burns that propose builds must carry a falsifier run before scaling; judge-lane-spec pass c proved escalate-rate on deterministic lanes would be schema-determined, so the conf_floor statistic is dead there.
rows.quote: escalate-rate is schema-determined, not calibrated: rule rows carry confidence 1.0 by construction, so the conf_floor statistic is dead on deterministic lanes
rows.steal: Before any 50-wide burn on a drafted gate, replay the schema over verdict history and prove the calibration statistic is alive on that lane class; exempt rule seats from calibration stats before scaling.
rows.falsifier: a scale-out burn whose receipt proposes a build with no pre-registered falsifier; contract demands Falsifier section only if a build is proposed, receipts without builds say none proposed
